metadata.title: Geometric Abstract Canvas with Impasto Stroke

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a grid of equilateral triangles with varied watercolor-like textures in warm and cool tones, bisected vertically by a thick, textured cobalt blue impasto paint stroke on a weathered off-white canvas background.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical blue stroke acts as a disruptive focal point over the geometric grid.
The grid of triangles creates a secondary rhythmic pattern behind the central stroke.
The rough canvas texture unifies the clean geometric shapes with the organic paint application.
coreInvariants: Off-white, aged canvas background with visible grain and vignetting.
Equilateral triangles arranged in a staggered, interlocking grid.
A single, thick, vertical blue paint stroke with visible bristles and impasto edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The blue stroke is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick cobalt blue stroke serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central blue stroke, moves upward to the display text, then scans the triangular grid patterns on either side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the central cluster, emphasizing the weathered canvas texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central blue stroke against muted, desaturated watercolor tones in the triangles.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use aged paper or canvas tones.
Limit the central stroke to a single primary blue.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a high horizontal bar.
The 'M' has a deep vertex reaching the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and modern feel.
Similar geometric structure and wide letterforms.
Geometric roots align with the triangular motifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a weathered, off-white canvas background. In the center, place a staggered grid of equilateral triangles featuring watercolor textures in yellow, orange, and light green. Overlay a thick, vertical, textured cobalt blue impasto paint stroke directly down the center, covering parts of the triangles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top center with wide tracking. Use a muted grey-brown color and apply a subtle grain texture to the letters to match the canvas.

verificationChecks: Is the blue stroke thick and textured?
Are the triangles arranged in a staggered grid?
Is the text centered at the top with wide tracking?
Does the background have a visible canvas grain?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central blue stroke
mustRedesign: Unique brushstroke patterns that exactly match the source
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue stroke looks like physical paint with depth.
Check that the triangles have varied internal textures.
Verify the text is perfectly centered and legible.
Confirm the overall color palette is muted except for the blue stroke.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a geometric grid of textured shapes with a single, high-contrast organic element (like a thick paint stroke) on a distressed material background, topped with widely-spaced geometric typography.
